content: Ɓakuli pusǝ kùli andǝ nzali
A tite ka Ɓakuli pusǝ kùli andǝ nzali.
Nzali ka pur kǝgìr ɗàng, nda kam anggo ɗulkǝm. Pǝndǝa gir mur mùr mǝlime. Sǝ Bangŋo mala Ɓakuli ka camarǝ gāɗi amur mùr.
Ɓakuli pak tǎlaban
Sǝ Ɓakuli na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ tǎlaban pusǝ rǝi.>> Pǝlǝa tǎlaban puro.
Ɓakuli sǝni ka tǎlaban ɓoaro, pǝlǝa tsǝk nzong anre tǎlaban andǝ pǝndǝa.
Ɓakuli tunǝ tǎlaban ama, <<pwari>> sǝ pǝndǝa ka tunǝi ama, <<dù.>> Pwari kya kpa, sǝ ban yi kwaro; mǝno nda nongŋo mǝdǝmbe.
Ɓakuli pak bumkuli, andǝ nza, andǝ nggeamùr
Sǝ Ɓakuli bang ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ nreban gau mùr mana a kùli andǝ mana a nzali ka.>>
Anggo sǝ pa. Ɓakuli tsǝk mǝnia yì nreban ngga yi nongŋo anre mùr mana a nzali andǝ mana a kùli ka.
Ɓakuli tunǝ mǝnia yì nreban ngga ama, <<bumkuli.>> Pwari kya kpa, sǝ ban yi kwaro; mǝno nda ɓaria nongŋo.
Ɓakuli na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ mùr mǝnana aɓata bumkuli ka, dapi a banɓwáná, sǝ ɓǝ̀ nza sa.>> Anggo sǝ pa.
Ɓakuli tunǝ nza ama, <<kwàrban>> sǝ ramba mala mùr ka tunǝi ama, <<nggeamùr.>> Ɓakuli sǝni ka ɓoaro.
Ɓakuli pak abondo andǝ anggun

Ɓakuli na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ nzali pusǝ agirpwala: abondo andǝ mbúgir mǝnana à nǝ̀ pusǝ mǝsǝia ka, andǝ anggun mǝnana à nǝ̀ pusǝ ɓǝlea nǝ amǝsǝia aɓalǝia ka. Komǝyenani le ka ɓǝ̀ pusǝ ulang male yì ɓeali.>> Anggo sǝ pa.
Nzali pusǝ agirpwala: abondo andǝ ambúgir mǝnana à kǝ pusǝ mǝsǝia ulangyia, andǝ anggun mǝnana à kǝ pusǝ ɓǝlea nǝ amǝsǝia aɓalǝia ka ulangyia. Ɓakuli sǝni ka ɓoaro.
Pwari kya kpa, sǝ ban yi kwaro; mǝno nda tàruià nongŋo.
Ɓakuli pak pwari andǝ zongŋo
Pǝlǝa Ɓakuli na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ atǎlaban pusǝ rǝia a bumkuli, ɓǝà gau nre pwari andǝ du. Ɓǝà duk agir-lǝmdǝa ace lǝmdǝ anongŋo, andǝ apǝlǝa, andǝ akúnì.
Sǝ amǝnia yì atǎlaban ngga ɓǝà tá a bumkuli amur ɓanza.>> Anggo sǝ pa.
Nda Ɓakuli pàk atǎlaban mǝgulke ɓari. Mǝgule mala ɓì, yì pwari ka, ɓǝ̀ kǝ tá nǝ pwari, sǝ mǝkyauwe, yì zongŋo ka, ɓǝ̀ kǝ tá nǝ du. Ɓakuli nyar ɗǝm ngga pusǝ anlero.
Ɓakuli tsǝk amǝnia yì atǎlaban ngga a bumkuli ɓǝà kǝ tá amúr ɓanza.
Ɓǝà kǝ yálmúr pwari andǝ du, sǝ ɓǝà gau nre tǎlaban andǝ pǝndǝa. Sǝ Ɓakuli sǝni ka ɓoaro.
Pwari kya kpa, sǝ ban yi kwaro. Mǝno nda inea nongŋo.
Ɓakuli pak agirkusǝu andǝ anji andǝ anyal
Ɓakuli na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ mùr lùmsǝ nǝ anji andǝ acili agir mǝyilǝmui mǝnana a mùr ka. Ɓǝ̀ bumkuli lùmsǝ nǝ koya ulang nyal.>>
Nda Ɓakuli pusǝki agirkusǝu mǝgulke mǝnana a nggeamùr, andǝ koya gìr mǝnana nǝyilǝmu kǝ ging mbǝl-mbǝl a mùr ka, andǝ koya ulang nyal. Ɓakuli sǝni ka ɓoaro.
Sǝ Ɓakuli tsǝkia wia bù, na ama, <<Wu ɓǝla, wu hatǝki, wu aki nggeamùr, sǝ ɓǝ̀ anyal hatǝki ɓanza.>>
Pwari kya kpa, sǝ ban yi kwaro; mǝno ka nda tongnoia nongŋo.

Ɓakuli nyare na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ nzali pusǝ koya ulang gìr mǝnana nǝyilǝmu ka: agirkusǝu andǝ agir-nzali mǝnana à kǝ púrǝ́ki nǝ múrbumia a nzali ka, andǝ koya ulang nyam-bondo andǝ nyam-ɓala.>> Anggo sǝ pa.
Ɓakuli pusǝ koya ulang girkusǝu, anyam-ɓala andǝ anyam-bondo, andǝ koya gìr mǝnana kǝ kuɗǝki a nzali ka. Ɓakuli sǝni ka ɓoaro.
Ɓakuli pak ɓwabura andǝ ɓwama
Pǝlǝa Ɓakuli na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ sǝm pàk ɓwapǝndǝa

ɓǝ̀ pa kǝla sǝm, ɓǝ̀ pur sǝm, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ yálmúr anji mǝnana aɓa nggeamùr, andǝ anyal mǝnana a bumkuli ka, agir-nzali andǝ agirkusǝu mǝnana kat à kǝ gāli a nzǝm-nzali, andǝ ɓanza kat, andǝ agiryilǝmu mǝnana kat à kǝ pūrǝki nǝ múrbumia a nzali ka.>>

content.text: Nda Ɓakuli pusǝ ɓwapǝndǝa kǝla yì.
Aɓa purban male yì Ɓakuli sǝ pusǝì.

content: Ɓakuli tsǝkia wia bù sǝ nea wia ama, <<Wu ɓǝla, wu hatǝki; wu lùmsǝ ɓanza. Wu akí ɓanza sǝ wu ɓunni.
Wu yálmúr anji mǝnana a mùr andǝ anyal mǝnana a bumkuli, andǝ koya gìr mǝnana ndanǝ yilǝmu kǝ gya a nzǝm-nzali ka.>>
Pǝlǝa Ɓakuli nea wia ama, <<Ən pana wun koya mbúgir andǝ bondo mǝnana kǝ pusǝ ɓeali a nzǝm-nzali kat ka, andǝ koya nggun mǝnana kǝ pusǝ ɓǝle nǝ mǝsǝì aɓalǝi ka. À nda ace girlina ma'wun.

Ən pana koya ulang mbúgir andǝ koya girpwala, nda girlina mala anyam-bondo mǝnana a ɓanza, andǝ anyal mǝnana a bumkuli, andǝ anyama mǝnana à kǝ pūrǝ nǝ múrbumia a nzali ka, andǝ koya gìr mǝnana ndanǝ yilǝmu ka.>> Anggo sǝ pa.
Ɓakuli sǝn gìr mǝnana pè kat ka, ɓoar kǝ̀rkǝ́r. Pwari kya kpa, sǝ ban yi kwaro; mǝno nda tongno-nong-mwashatia nongŋo.

footnotes.text: ɓwapǝndǝa nǝ kún Ibǝru ka nda adamu.
